author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
We utilize RingCentral Meetings for all our support groups.  This free app is available for Mac, PC, Android, iPhone, and ChromeOS.  You probably already have it, but if not just click on the link above to install the app and create a free account..

As we are an MBSAQIP-accredited center, we are required to take attendance for all support groups. Please fill out the form below with your real name. You will be directed to the login link after you submit the form.

NOTE: These meetings are recorded and posted on our web site, YouTube, and socials for patients to review.  Please be aware of this if you are using your full name in Ringcentral, or turning on your video camera.

Join Devon Price RD, LD and Dr. Henry Huson in a discussion about body contouring after weight loss.

Dr. Huson brings a patient-centered approach that blends artistry with humanism. His passion is to provide safe, high-quality care that enhances natural beauty while staying true to who patients are. He is known for his approachable and compassionate style.

The foundation of his care is humanism in medicine: listening deeply, treating each patient with compassion, and respecting their unique goals and story.

Dr. Huson’s passion is to provide safe, high-quality care that enhances a patient’s natural beauty while staying true to who they are. He believes plastic surgery should help patients feel more confident in their own skin.

“I don’t believe plastic surgery should change someone into a different person — instead, it should help them feel more confident in their own skin. For me, the foundation of excellent care has always

been humanism in medicine: listening deeply, treating each patient with compassion, and respecting their unique goals and story.

That approach shapes every consultation, every procedure, and every relationship I build with my patients.”

This support group has passed! Check on our YouTube Channel for past meetings.
